name: Triphala Powder
original_description:
Triphala Powder – 100g | A Time-Honored Ayurvedic Blend of Three Sacred Fruits

Rooted in centuries of Ayurvedic wisdom, our Triphala Powder is a carefully balanced combination of three revered fruits: Amalaki (Emblica officinalis), Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), and Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica). Each ingredient is hand-selected for quality, organically grown, and stone-ground to honor traditional preparation methods and preserve the natural essence of the herbs.

This classic formulation has been part of daily routines across generations — not as a remedy, but as a gentle, ritualistic practice aligned with Ayurvedic principles of harmony and mindful living. Whether mixed with warm water, honey, or herbal infusion, Triphala offers a simple way to connect with an enduring tradition of herbal care.

Why Falcon Herbs Triphala Powder?
- 100% pure, organic-certified herbs — no fillers, additives, or synthetic preservatives
- Traditionally prepared using time-honored stone-grinding techniques
- Sustainably sourced and ethically harvested
- Packaged in a resealable, eco-conscious pouch to protect freshness and potency

How to Use:
As part of a daily ritual, take ½ to 1 teaspoon with warm water, once or twice daily — optionally before meals or at bedtime. For personalized guidance on integrating herbal practices into your routine, consult a qualified Ayurvedic professional.

Storage:
Store in a cool, dry place. Keep tightly sealed after opening to maintain quality.

Triphala is a traditional Ayurvedic herbal blend intended for daily wellness rituals. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition.
